title: Hosts — CPU package power
description: RAPL package/domain power and amdgpu PPT. This is CPU PACKAGE power, not wall power — it excludes NVMe, fans, PSU loss and (n5pro) the five drive bays. No machine total exists here.

panels.title: CPU package power (RAPL package-0)
panels.description: The package-0 RAPL domain of each physical Proxmox host, in watts, from the native telegraf agent's exec input (#194). This is CPU PACKAGE power, not wall power — it excludes NVMe, fans, PSU loss and (n5pro) the five drive bays. No machine total exists here. Every rapl_power_watts sample is a 2 s spot measurement taken once per 60 s collection interval, not a 60 s average (files/rapl_power.sh is deliberately stateless — a state file would add reboot and stale-state failure classes, since a boot resets energy_uj and wrap-correction would turn that into a fabricated spike). Short bursts between samples are therefore invisible.

panels.title: Package power now
panels.description: Latest package-0 reading per host. This is CPU PACKAGE power, not wall power — it excludes NVMe, fans, PSU loss and (n5pro) the five drive bays. No machine total exists here. No thresholds: neither board has a measured package-power ceiling here that a colour could honestly mean, and no alert rule is paired with this dashboard — per-family absence design belongs to #202.

panels.title: RAPL domains — 2 s spot sample per minute
panels.description: Every domain each host exposes, tagged from the sysfs `name` file rather than the (boot-unstable) index: eq12 reports package-0, core and uncore, n5pro package-0 and core — the shapes genuinely differ and nothing here hard-wires either. n5pro's core reading of roughly 0.04 W at idle is REAL, not a fabricated zero: it is Zen5 core power-gating, and a 6 s single-core load moved it to 4.41 W while the package went 5.79 → 22.44 W (measured 2026-08-25). eq12's uncore sitting at 0 at idle is likewise real — an idle iGPU. A domain that cannot be READ is absent rather than zero. Every rapl_power_watts sample is a 2 s spot measurement taken once per 60 s collection interval, not a 60 s average (files/rapl_power.sh is deliberately stateless — a state file would add reboot and stale-state failure classes, since a boot resets energy_uj and wrap-correction would turn that into a fabricated spike). Short bursts between samples are therefore invisible.

panels.title: n5pro iGPU (amdgpu PPT)
panels.description: The host-side cost of CT-201's VAAPI workloads (Frigate, Immich), from the amdgpu chip's ppt feature via the sensors input that #186 already deployed — this panel adds no collection. It is the iGPU package tracking power, separate from and not additive with the RAPL domains above. eq12 has no equivalent series: it is an Intel N100 whose iGPU power is inside the package-0 domain.
